response.text:
The facts give no fixed period for how long the employer must keep the results of checks on work equipment. They only say that the records must be kept and made available.

Fact 11 (DLGS71, art. 71, c. 11) says the employer's check reports (verbali delle verifiche) must be kept and made available to the supervisory body. Fact 47 adds that documents are kept at the plant site. The 10-year, 5-year and 15-year periods in the other facts apply to manufacturers, notified bodies and importers, not to the employer's check results.
